import os, textwrap, collections
prog='''from collections import Counter\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]\n    marks = {(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg}\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    # Extend each row/column containing multiple marks between its outermost marks.\n    for r in range(h):\n        cols = [c for rr, c in marks if rr == r]\n        if len(cols) >= 2:\n            for c in range(min(cols), max(cols) + 1):\n                if out[r][c] == bg:\n                    out[r][c] = 2\n    for c in range(w):\n        rows = [r for r, cc in marks if cc == c]\n        if len(rows) >= 2:\n            for r in range(min(rows), max(rows) + 1):\n                if out[r][c] == bg:\n                    out[r][c] = 2\n    return out\n'''
